subject: Medford Teacher Equity Scholarship
overview: Medford High School educators discussed the background and ongoing fundraising efforts for the Medford Teacher Equity Scholarship, an initiative established to support students of color pursuing careers in education.

items.title: Introductions and Local Medford Dining
items.summary: High school music teacher Sarah Fard and guidance counselor Joel Menasha introduced themselves and shared their favorite dining spots in Medford.

items.title: Teaching and Programs at Medford High School
items.summary: Fard and Menasha described their paths to education, highlighting the school's diverse student population, accessible music electives, and vocational programming.

items.title: Medford Teacher Equity Scholarship
items.summary: The guests explained the origins, nonprofit structure, and mission of the scholarship fund created to reduce financial barriers for students of color entering teaching programs.

items.title: GSA Scholarship Acknowledgments and Closing
items.summary: Menasha thanked Balocca for past community fundraising efforts benefiting scholarships for members of the high school Gay-Straight Alliance.
